entry.title: Logic Test v0.3.0
entry.content:
## Sphere model fix: locked placements no longer break lock-step
Fixed the bug where locked in-game placements in the under-test game (vanilla or shuffled badges, HMs, key items) caused interleaved keys — e.g. lots of `KEY_12` arriving while `KEY_11` was still incomplete — along with false `LOGIC LEAK` warnings in the client. These items are never gated by the KEY spheres, so the player picks them up mid-sphere in real play; the sphere model now collects them via closure (like events) in both `count_events` modes, restoring the lock-step guarantee: a `KEY_(i+1)` is never legitimately reachable before every `KEY_i`.
Related hardening: - The unreachable-marker pass uses the same networkable-location predicate as the sphere computation. - Generation fails loudly if the fixed-location snapshot hook didn't run, instead of silently falling back to post-fill lock flags. - Non-advancement items are skipped in the closure sets (they can't affect reachability). - New regression test replays gated play via `MultiWorld.get_spheres` against a slot with shuffled (locked) badges/HMs.
## Client improvements
- **Leak tracking persists across reconnects**: keys received ahead of the current sphere are recorded in server data storage (per team/slot), so leak history survives reconnects and item replays. Leaked spheres are flagged in the status output and GUI with the sphere they arrived on. - **Per-sphere key totals**: the status list and GUI tab now show have/required key counts for every sphere (done / now / locked), not just the current one.
## Upgrade notes
Seeds generated with 0.2.1 or earlier keep their old (misgrouped) key assignment — the fix applies at generation time, so affected multiworlds need a regen. Existing games remain playable; the early keys are safe and the leak warnings they trigger are spurious.

entry.title: Black Market of Bulletphilia ~ 100th Black Market v0.4.5
entry.content:
Archipelago Randomizer implementation for **_Black Market of Bulletphilia ~ 100th Black Market_**, also known as _**Touhou 18.5**_.
- **.apworld version:** 0.4.5 - **Minimum Archipelago Launcher version:** 0.6.7
Recommended to play on Windows, as **the game does not support Linux natively**. If playing on Linux, it is recommended to run both Archipelago Launcher and the game in Wine/Proton.
# Changelog - Added `Izanagi Object - Dragon Gem` item and its own item group. - Added **Dragon Gem Hunt goal**: the player must collect a certain number of `Izanagi Object - Dragon Gem`s before victory is achieved. This is a treasure hunt mode similar to Yoshi Island's Luigi Hunt and Super Mario World's Yoshi Egg Hunt goals. - Added options **Dragon Gems Required** and **Dragon Gems in Pool**. - Quality-of-life: `One-time` Items will now apply to the next run if they are received at the end of a stage. - Quality-of-life: The game will now NOT cap lives at 7 despite being able to carry up to 11. - Quality-of-life: There can now be up to 16 Equip Cost upgrade items in the item pool, totalling up to 900% Equip Cost if fully upgraded. Only applicable when playing with **Itemized Equipment Upgrades** set to **Separate**. - Fixed the 17th Ability Card loadout slot onwards containing Blank Card by default. - Fixed .yaml templates generating without Progression Balancing and Accessibility options.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/furret78/ArchipelagoHBM/compare/unstable-0.4.4...0.4.5
# Game Details and Setup - See **game details** [here](https://github.com/furret78/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/th185/docs/en_100th%20Black%20Market.md). When exporting .yaml files for this game, it is recommended to use the Options Creator in the Archipelago Launcher for a smooth experience. - See the **setup guide** [here](https://github.com/furret78/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/th185/docs/setup_en.md).

entry.title: Dark Souls Remastered v0.2.5
entry.content:
# **Dark Souls Remastered Archipelago v0.2.5** ## Pausing and Prison update
### Version update -> 0.2.5. **Client is compatible with 0.2.x generated apworlds**. All relevant changes are to the client only. The only change to the apworld from 0.2.4 is a version number update. ## Features * Pauses the game while the Gesture menu is open. The behavior can be toggled off via the "Custom Controls" window in DSAP client settings. Items received during the pause will still be acquired. Deathlinks received while paused will both kill you and unpause. * DA/PW Warp Safety - Removes the warp prohibition which the game applies while player is in DA Prison cell or the Painted World. * DA Prison Break Cutscene Safety - resets the flags that get set if you've pulled the lever twice, allowing the gate to the Pisacas to open. * Additional options are available for the client's Font size. ## Fixes * "Ghosts are not ghostly" setting now also removes the property of their attacks which make them unblockable while not cursed. * Tracker autotabbing detected wrong map in a part of Upper Undead Burg.
Known issues (will be addressed in a later release) 1) Rare crash related to bonfire syncing code. 2) Petrus may aggro on you if you hurt his companions.

entry.title: OpenTTD v1.4.1r2
entry.content: Connecting now actually starts the session: the status line turns green, vehicles stay locked until their item arrives, missions and stars track progress, checks reach the server and the goal fires. Resume sync marks already-checked missions, stars and shop slots as done instead of offering them again, and a game started from a seed's Join card receives that seed's data instead of leftovers from an earlier run. Requires plugin 1.2.0 (included).

entry.title: OpenTTD v1.4.1r3
entry.content: Started from the launcher, the game now goes straight in: no start dialog, no fields to fill. It loads this seed's own savegame when one exists and generates the world when none does; quitting — and every autosave — writes that per-seed save, so the next press of Play continues where you left off. Each seed keeps its own save, so two seeds can never pick up each other's progress. Requires plugin 1.2.1 (included).

entry.title: OpenTTD v1.4.1r4
entry.content: Started from the launcher, the game receives its world data reliably — a race between the launcher's hand-off and the game's start could leave the title screen sitting idle — and the manual Archipelago connect buttons do nothing under the launcher: London already holds the login, and no window may ask for it again. Requires launcher 3.7.35 and plugin 1.2.2 (included).

entry.title: OpenTTD v1.4.1r5
entry.content: Every save now refreshes the seed's own savegame — the file auto-continue loads. Save from the menu under any name, let an autosave run, or just quit: the next press of Play in the launcher picks up exactly where you were, and a crash after a manual save no longer loses anything. Plugin 1.2.2 unchanged (included).

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.7.0
entry.content: ## Changes - The server no longer freezes at the end of a wave. Every engineer worked out where to move its nest in the same frame; they take turns now. - Engineers stop holding wave one's nest for the whole mission, and upgrade it instead. - Engineers no longer move their nest between waves. It crashed the server at every wave transition, so it is off until it works. `sm_redbots_manager_engineer_nest_relocate 1` turns it back on. - A bot that is hurt or low on ammo guards the bomb from a dispenser beside it, instead of walking off to find a health pack. - `tf2ap.exe` carries an icon and says what it is in its file properties. - Windows still warns about `tf2ap.exe`. The install guide says why, and every release now publishes `SHA256SUMS` and links a VirusTotal report so you can check what you downloaded. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. SmartScreen calls the exe an unrecognized app; Defender sometimes flags it. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The launcher unpacks archives into your TF2 directory, writes SourceMod's DLLs there, downloads a game server and starts it, which is what an installer does and also what a dropper does, and the file is not signed yet, so a scanner has nothing to weigh against the heuristic. [TODO item 13](https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/blob/main/TODO.md#13-sign-the-windows-exe-open) is the fix. Check the file below instead of trusting it, or build it yourself with `make launcher`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`.env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/.env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. entry.title: Mario Sports Mix v3.0.0
entry.content:
# What's Changed? ## Alternate Paths - **Alternate Paths have been added! Clear missions along them to send locations.** - **Alternate Path Type**: Choose between per-cup and progressive alternate paths, as well as the option to merge locations between sports and/or difficulties. - **Always Spawn Alt Paths**: Choose to auto-unlock the alternate paths, bypassing the need to meet the criterias in the original game. - **Quality of Life**: Use Left/Right on the D-Pad when starting a new tournament to select your side to minimize the need for RNG. - **Alternate Path Guide**: In addition, several maps and a guide have been included to help those unfamiliar with the alternate paths.
## Cosmetic Options - **Replace All Opponent Characters**: Turns all your opponents into a single character! You can even change the Hockey Goalies and Dodgeball Yoshis! - **Music Shuffle**: Shuffles around the game's music! (Note that some menu tracks cannot be shuffled) - **Tint Stages**: Applies a random tint to each stage to spice up the visuals a bit!
## Quality of Life Changes - **Restrict Sports Mix**: Makes it so Sports Mix can only pull from enabled sports. - **Start with Random Mushroom Cups**: You can now start with 1-7 random mushroom cups (+ courts). - **Points to Win**: Changed Points to Win so that it applies for the whole match, rather than just the set. - **Progressive Courts**: Progressive Courts now use a different order that should make progression smoother. - <sub>Mario Stadium > Koopa Troopa Beach > Peach's Castle > Toad Park > DK Dock > Western Junction > Luigi's Mansion > Wario Factory > Daisy Garden > Waluigi Pinball > Bowser Jr. Blvd > Ghoulish Galleon > Bowser's Castle > Star Ship > Behemoth Stage<sub/>
## Bug Fixes - Fixed some logic pertaining to Sports Mix - Updated some older functions to use newly discovered memory addresses - Fixed a bug where changing from one Mario Sports Mix player to another without closing the client would cause the new Mario Sports Mix player to instantly check all locations checked from the first player. - Fixed a bug where duplicate courts got added to the itempool if the court was part of Party Mode, but was also precollected at the start.

Bumping one still works the same way. - **The four vanilla spell-classroom blockers finally talk.** The Rictusempra, Skurge, Diffindo and Spongify classroom bookcases were silent even on contact. I expect something to break. - CHANGED: Players now get 2 Emotion Limit Break items from the start - ADDED: Built-in AP Client inside the game that can be opened/closed by pressing Tab: - Archipelago tab contains chat window which shows every received AP message, and which you can use to chat with other players/use commands from the game. - Hints tab shows all the known hints related to your game. Burning BoE gives max amount of drops in that bundle. There is a limited amount of bundles per chapter, meaning that if logic places more BoEs in a chapter than there is bundles, you won't be able to burn all BoEs until you unlock next chapter. - Booster Packs are also present in this mode but nerfed to 4 drops per pack! - IMPORTANT: Old "Battle Graph" Mode is supposed to get removed next update, but if you actually liked it and think it can be improved, PLEASE send feedback. - REMOVED: Filler Item option (Was too lazy to add support for BoE for "Battle Graph" mode. entry.content:

## Bug Fixes - Baggage can no longer be placed on the MC Grind Rail location, causing you to potentially fall underneath the death plane during the collection cutscene. - Fixed some cases where baggage would collect multiple times on loading a save.
# Resources
Requires latest AP Branch of the Psychonauts Randomizer Mod to run, found here: https://github.com/Akashortstack/PsychoRando/releases
Setup Guide with installation instructions and additional information for PsychoRando here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1b7QOnOLmTSvdC7A1YK3bsSmhtSOsAMs0XF5j-tyE6Zw/edit?usp=sharing
Requires Astralathe to run, download and installation instructions found here: https://gitlab.com/scrunguscrungus/astralathe/-/wikis/Installing%20Astralathe
PopTracker Pack created by Mysteryem here: https://github.com/Mysteryem/Psychonauts_AP_PopTracker/releases
# Psychonauts Archipelago Setup Guide
## Setting up the required mods 1. Install Psychonauts for PC, Astralathe, and the Psychonauts Randomizer Mod from the AP Companion Branch. Full Psychonauts Randomizer and Astralathe setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1b7QOnOLmTSvdC7A1YK3bsSmhtSOsAMs0XF5j-tyE6Zw/edit?usp=sharing **Make sure Astralathe is up to date, use the AP Companion Branch of PsychoRando, and make sure to open the game with AstralatheLauncher.exe at least once.**
2. Download the psychonauts.apworld and install (easiest method is by trying to open the apworld file, Archipelago will install automatically)
3. Open the Archipelago Launcher and run the Psychonauts Client. If you get an error message saying the root_directory could not be found, follow steps 4-5. Otherwise, skip to step 6.
4. Find the folder that contains your Psychonauts and Astralathe installation, and copy the folder directory. For example, the most common place for the Steam version is "C:\\\\Program Files (x86)\\\\Steam\\\\steamapps\\\\common\\\\Psychonauts"
5. Run ArchipelagoLauncher.exe and open host.yaml from the Archipelago Launcher, find the psychonauts_options and paste your psychonauts game directory into the root_directory setting between the quotes. **If the root directory contains single slashes between lines, change all of these to double slashes. If you don't, the client will fail to open**
6. Click "Generate Template Settings". This will open file explorer Find "Psychonauts.yaml" and copy it to /Players/ (create this folder if it does not exist)
7. Open the YAML file and change the line that says "name: Player{number}" to your desired player name. Adjust the settings in the YAML to your liking
8. Run ArchipelagoGenerate.exe
9. Take the newly created AP_XXX.zip file in /output/ in upload it here: https://archipelago.gg/uploads then create a room
10. Download patch file next to your player name, then unzip the file. This contains a file called RandoSeed.lua
11. Find your Psychonauts game directory and open /ModResource/PsychoRando/Scripts
12. Paste RandoSeed.lua from your generated Archipelago file into this folder. Replace the file in the destination if needed.
13. Run AstralatheLauncher.exe to open the game. You should see your player number and name on the menu screen, along with your current randomizer version.
14. From the menu, enter the yellow door to start a new game.
15. From the Archipelago Launcher, open the Psychonauts Client and connect to your server hosted on archipelago.gg
16. Once you've started a new save file and connected to the server, you can start playing!

This version of the Candy Box 2 randomizer introduces the following features: - New goal conditions are now available. - Goal conditions are implemented as a set of tasks to be performed - In addition to obtaining the PLAY stones, you can also opt to require dying to the Castle Trap Room or swimming 3000m in the sea. - Any subset of these tasks can be made as a requirement to goal the game. - Your progress towards these goals can be found by finding the Talking Candy. - Filler locations have been overhauled. - Filler locations now exist in the Lollipop Farm and as distances travelled in the sea. - Filler locations are randomly selected when required. - Opting for Individual Spells now adds filler locations instead of bundling multiple items into one shop purchase at the Sorceress' hut. - Hovering over the World Map in your Inventory now tells you how many Progressive World Maps you have received. - You can now have up to 20 font traps in the world. - Logic has been updated for single enemy quests - the Purple Fin is now taken into account.
Tested on AP 0.6.7, YMMV on later versions. Requires AP 0.6.0 or later.
Game client available at: https://candybox2-ap.vicr123.com/20260822-1/

entry.title: Refunct v1.5.0
entry.content: - Refunct now uses Rulebuilder! You will need at least Archipelago 0.6.7 from now on. # Custom maps in Archipelago! - You can now play custom maps and they'll give checks in Archipelago. Every button is a check for a total of 37 checks. Enable the Custom Minigame in your yaml. - You can use any custom map you want! Here's my recommended list (currently only 2 maps): [link to archipelago discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1273001824919617577/1540723304296353824). - Here's how to install them: download the maps you want. Then open Refunct and the mod. Press CTRL+SHIFT+M and select "Open Maps Folder". Place your custom map there (it's probably `AppData\Roaming\refunct-tas\maps`). - Once you unlock the Custom minigame and you select it, you will be asked directly which custom map you want to play, you can select it there. You can (re)start whichever you want. - You can make custom maps too with the editor! # Map editor improvements - Pressing `c` and triggering the next cluster should now work better. - You can now press `left`/`right`/`up`/`down`/`pageup`/`pagedown` to work in 3 dimensions without having to toggle. - `TAB` now opens the advanced editor of the selected element, if any.

entry.title: Pokemon FireRed and LeafGreen v1.1.0
entry.content:
ROM CHECKSUM: `00939B09`
[Setup Guide](https://github.com/vyneras/Archipelago/blob/1.1.0/worlds/pokemon_frlg/docs/setup_en.md) [Rom Changes](https://github.com/vyneras/Archipelago/blob/1.1.0/worlds/pokemon_frlg/docs/rom%20changes.md)
**Game Updates** - Using Teleport on the field will return you to the interior of the last Pokémon Center you visited if Pokémon Centers are shuffled - Increased the amount of coins that you can hold to 50000 - Added 3000 coins and 5000 coins purchase options at the Celadon Game Corner - Dexsanity rewards for Pokémon you catch before getting the Pokédex will now be given to you immediately upon getting the Pokédex. You no longer need to get the Pokédex rated by Oak or at a PC
**Apworld Updates** - Converted logic to use Rule Builder (requires AP version 0.6.7 or higher) - Updated several region and entrance names for better clarity in the spoiler log and when using UT - Option groups have been added - New option `skip_intro` - Set whether the vanilla intro sequence where you get your starter Pokémon from Oak's Lab should be skipped or not. If the intro is skipped then you will be prompted to select your starter Pokémon during Oak's initial speech - This setting is forced on if Random Starting Town or any type of Entrance Randomization is on - Updated option `shuffle_pokemon_centers` - Now includes the Player's House though your starting town's Pokémon Center entrance will never lead there - Updated option `mix_entrance_warp_pools` - Added `Pokemon Centers` as an option - Your starting town's Pokémon Center entrance is guaranteed to lead to a Pokémon Center - Added `Warp Tiles` as an option - Warp Tiles will only be mixed if using `full` Warp Tiles shuffle - Added `Dropdowns` as an option - Dropdowns will only be mixed is using `full` Dropdown shuffle and entrances/warps are decoupled - Updated option `prizesanity` - The coin price for purchasing items at the Game Corner Prize Room will now be determined by what item it is - Updated option `shop_prices` and `consistent_shop_prices` - Now applies to Game Corner Prize Room item purchases as well - Updated option `trainersanity` - Split into `kanto_trainersanity` and `sevii_trainersanity` options - New option `item_appearance_matches_contents` - Changes the color of item balls to match their contents. Green balls contain progression items, blue balls contain useful items, and red balls contain filler items. Traps will be a random color between the three - Removed option `modify_world_state` - The options that were originally under this have been broken into individual options to allow greater control over them - New option `elevators_condition` - Sets the conditions the Celadon Department Store and Silph Co. elevators are in. Has no logical implications unless interior warps are shuffled - Open: The elevators can be used normally - Locked: The elevators will require the Lift Key before they can be used - Disabled: The elevators are completely unusable - New option `elite_four_rematch_requirement` - Sets the requirement for challenging the Elite Four Rematch between badges or gyms - New option `cheaper_coins` - Reduces the cost of buying coins from the Celadon Game Corner by 90% - Update option `game_option` - Added new option `Encounter Mode` - Random: Encounters are chosen randomly based on the encounter rates - Boost: Encounters are chosen based on the encounter rates with a higher chance for Pokémon that haven't already been caught - Rotate: Encounters are chosen by rotating through the encounter slots in an area (multiple slots in a row can be the same Pokémon)
**Bug Fixes** - Fixed an issue where the Pokédex was accessible in the Safari Zone even when you didn't have it - Fixed an issue where items that should only be purchasable once could be purchased multiple times at the Celadon Game Corner Prize Room Shops - Fixed an issue where logic could expect you to board the Seagallop from the harbor side of Vermilion City and sail to the main part of the city without any tickets/passes
**Known Issues** - The `base_stats` option does not affect Deoxys attack/defense forms - The Rival battle in Oak's Lab can occasionally softlock the game. Recommend saving before triggering the battle - Registering an evolution item and using it from the field will softlock the game

entry.title: Pokemon BW Extra Logic Plugin v1.10.0
entry.content:
**Fixes** * Fixed a missing connection between Route 5 and Nimbasa City * Fixed a generation error when Mistralton City is selected as starting town and `shuffle_badges: shuffle` * Skyla will now always give the Jet Badge or the Quake Badge if `starting_town = "Mistralton City"` and `shuffle_badges: shuffle`
**YAML Options List** * The following options need to be added to the Black and White YAML under `plugin_options`: ``` plugin_options: extra_logic: # same as v8 randomize_starting_town: true starting_town_blacklist: [] # list in README add_ss_ticket: true add_pass: true hm_with_badges: true add_rock_smash: true add_rock_smash_musharna: true # requires add_rock_smash extra_cut_trees: true extra_cut_trees_kyurem: true # requires extra_cut_trees move_strength_boulders: true move_strength_boulders_vi_road: true # requires move_strength_boulders dark_areas: ["Wellspring Cave B1F", "Mistralton Cave", "Challengers Cave"] # supports "_All" and "_Random", see README ```
**Important Notes** * The plugin needs to be installed by the host before generation. The player also needs the plugin to patch their ROM. * It is not possible to add the extra logic options mid-playthrough.
**Backwards Compatibility** * This version is compatible with v0.3.37+ of the main BW APworld * This version is compatible with v23 of the QoL Plugin
